skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply models such as VaR, term structure models, volatility models to measure market risk and calculate capital requirements for market risk.
Apply structural default models, statistical methods to estimate credit risk parameters (PD, LGD, EAD) and calculate expected losses, unexpected losses, economic capital for credit risk.
Apply methods to calculate capital requirements for specific cases of operational risk according to Basel II; measure market liquidity risk and fund liquidity risk.
Develop skills to build models and analyze strategies (accept, avoid, mitigate, transfer) for managing market risk in financial institutions.
Develop skills to build models and analyze strategies (accept, avoid, mitigate, transfer) for managing credit risk in financial institutions.
Develop skills to build models and analyze strategies (accept, avoid, mitigate, transfer) for managing operational risk and liquidity in financial institutions.
Develop ability to learn independently, organize and manage group work, summarize issues and persuade others.
Develop personal responsibility, responsibility towards the group, build discipline in learning.
